top_signals.title: Qatar Extends LNG Force Majeure as Hormuz Traffic Remains Halted
top_signals.summary: Qatar extended force majeure on liquefied natural gas supplies to European and Asian buyers by another month as uncertainty over the full reopening of the Strait of Hormuz clouds prospects for restoring Persian Gulf energy flows.

top_signals.title: Japan to incorporate AI into the handling of emergency calls
top_signals.summary: The Fire and Disaster Management Agency plans to introduce a system that automatically transcribes emergency calls and assists staff on follow-up action.

top_signals.title: Sanctioning the International Criminal Court: The view from Tokyo
top_signals.summary: Japan is right to support the ICC and its Japanese president. But support should not mean treating the institution as immune from scrutiny.
